title: Verifier Claim Registry - v6
description: Heterogeneous multi-principal Work v2 claims. These claims preserve the narrower Work v1 claims and do not infer provider outcome from valid authorization evidence.

claims.name: permit.work_authority_manifest.v2
claims.assertion: A signed Work v2 package binds one exact heterogeneous authority population, one verified root principal, exact lane delegations, and at most one finite single-currency customer-economic-value pool.
claims.required_evidence: A supported signed Work root Permit; strict keel.work_package.v2; every strict keel.work_authority.v2 object; canonical authority and set hashes; exact delegation population; and matching project, root, resource, Policy, and time identities.

claims.name: permit.work_child_containment.v2
claims.assertion: Each supplied Work v2 child is bound to one signed lane, exact action and resource, authenticated exercising principal, root delegation, value-binding mode, and supported trusted facts required by that mode.
claims.required_evidence: A supported Work v2 authority manifest; signed exact child Permit; signed keel.work_binding.v2; matching request, action, semantic, resource, principal, delegation, credential digest, window, use, value and provider-fact material; and self-contained referenced artifact bytes.

claims.name: permit_chain.execution_authorized_at_boundary.v2
claims.assertion: A supplied Work v2 dispatch-boundary record is pre-effect, signed, exact-request-bound, and records successful rechecks of the root, lane, child, delegation, principal, authenticated credential, review, Policy, reservation, revocation, expiry, idempotency, and provider body.
claims.required_evidence: A supported contained Work v2 child and a signature-valid dispatch-boundary artifact whose exact identities, hashes, timestamps, liveness checks, and gate outcome match that child and its signed authority chain.
does_not_establish: absence of execution outside the governed boundary

claims.name: permit.work_value_conservation.v2
claims.assertion: One root-wide hash-linked customer-economic-value ledger conserves the signed finite Work v2 pool across every monetary lane and principal while non-monetary lanes consume none of that pool.
claims.required_evidence: A supported Work v2 authority manifest; complete signed-scope population of strict keel.work_value_event.v2 events; monotonic root sequences and event hashes; exact reservation identities; matching currency; recomputed after-state; and supported provider facts for provider-verified consumption.
does_not_establish: activity outside the declared Keel-recorded scope

claims.name: permit.work_exact_review.v1
claims.assertion: Each supplied Work review transition is signature-valid, freezes the exact challenged request, records the human outcome, and separately records the authorization result after current Work authority and Policy were re-evaluated.
claims.required_evidence: A supported challenged Work v2 child; strict signed keel.work_review_transition.v1; matching root, lane, project, Permit, request and review hashes; matching terminal decision state; current-phase Policy snapshot; and no dispatch evidence when the final decision is deny.
does_not_establish: the natural-person identity or organizational role behind actor_id
